name: LINE
label: LINE — LINE Messaging API
description: LINE via the official LINE Messaging API. Base https://api.line.me/v2. Docs: https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/. Messaging API only. LINE Notify ended 2025-04-01 — do not implement Notify. Canonical vs social-media.md Line row — same node. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One LINE operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"push-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: push-message | reply-message | multicast | broadcast | get-profile | get-content | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: first verb.

schema.label: to
schema.description: User, group, or room id for push-message; list of user ids for multicast. Official to.

schema.label: replyToken
schema.description: Webhook reply token for reply-message. Official replyToken. Single use.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: LINE Messaging API messages [{type, text, …}]. type EXACT typical: text | image | video | audio | sticker | location | flex. Max 5.

schema.label: notificationDisabled
schema.description: Official notificationDisabled. Suppresses device notification on push/reply/multicast/broadcast.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: push-message, reply-message, multicast, broadcast, get-profile, get-content, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Channel access token
configurationParameters.description: LINE channel access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Channel Secret
configurationParameters.description: LINE channel secret for listen webhook x-line-signature verification (StudioQuack secret). Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
